scope_note: Public first-party pages establish feature families and supported parent codes, but delegate exact native invocation, lobsterin grammar, provider-specific file contracts, and complete output schemas to the licensed package manual/examples. Those details remain manual-required.

capabilities.purpose: Use VASP plane-wave results as a LOBSTER parent.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact 5.1.1 files/settings are manual-required; a software name or WAVECAR-like filename is insufficient.

capabilities.purpose: Use ABINIT plane-wave results as a LOBSTER parent.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact 5.1.1 files/settings are manual-required and this Skill has no validated ABINIT adapter.

capabilities.purpose: Use Quantum ESPRESSO plane-wave results as a LOBSTER parent.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact supported QE versions, pseudopotentials, wavefunction/save artifacts, and conversion settings are manual-required; this route is design-only in the Skill.

capabilities.purpose: Project energy-resolved COHP from plane-wave/PAW wavefunctions.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact lobsterin keywords and 5.1.1 output schema are manual-required.

capabilities.purpose: Project energy-resolved COOP from plane-wave DFT output.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact lobsterin keywords and 5.1.1 output schema are manual-required.

capabilities.purpose: Evaluate energy-resolved crystal orbital bond indices and their integrated values as basis-bound solid-state bond-index descriptors.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact 5.1.1 lobsterin syntax and output schema are manual-required; preserve two-/multi-center definition, selector, basis, spin, Fermi reference, and integration window.

capabilities.purpose: Produce reliable atom-projected density of states from the local projection.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact lobsterin keywords, orbital/spin layout, and 5.1.1 output schema are manual-required.

capabilities.purpose: Compute local-orbital population and atomic-charge quantities.
capabilities.call_contract: Exact 5.1.1 task keywords/output schema are manual-required and oxidation-state conclusions remain expert-only.
Exact 5.1.1 task syntax/artifacts are manual-required and no current fixture validates this surface.

capabilities.purpose: Assess resemblance between original and reconstructed wavefunctions with a spilling indicator in the interval from one to zero, lower being better.
capabilities.call_contract: No universal acceptance threshold is supplied; predeclare claim-specific charge and total spilling limits and retain basis evidence.

capabilities.purpose: Project plane waves onto a proper local auxiliary basis and record its exact identity.
capabilities.call_contract: Basis family/resource hash and per-element orbitals must match the authorized 5.1.1 resources and observed output; low spilling alone does not prove chemical completeness.

capabilities.purpose: Configure a LOBSTER task through lobsterin.
capabilities.call_contract: Do not generate keywords from memory; require the exact authorized 5.1.1 manual/example identity and review.

capabilities.purpose: Launch the licensed LOBSTER binary in a prepared parent directory.
capabilities.call_contract: Public first-party pages do not state the exact executable filename/argv; an execution plan is blocked until the authorized 5.1.1 manual and binary identity are provided.

capabilities.purpose: Interpret 5.1.1 completion, spilling, basis, COHP/COOP/DOS, list, structure, charge, and auxiliary outputs.
capabilities.call_contract: The complete file names, schemas, completion marker, and fatal markers require the authorized 5.1.1 manual plus genuine artifacts.

capabilities.purpose: Analyze and plot existing LOBSTER COHP/COOP/COBI and DOS artifacts with LobsterPy.
capabilities.call_contract: Companion documentation is authoritative for LobsterPy calls only; it cannot establish native LOBSTER syntax, projection quality, or missing interactions.
